title: The Grateful Dead Live at Avalon Ballroom on 1968-10-12
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> Tascam SS-R05 -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: A breathtaking sound‑board capture of an iconic 1968 show, highlighted by a monster The Eleven and a majestic Other One.
ai_review.review: The Miller‑upgraded soundboard tape delivers crystal‑clear audio that lets every nuance of the band shine.  From the soaring St. Stephen > The Eleven to the primal Other One and the double New Potato Caboose, the performance is repeatedly described as perfect, lyrical and electric.  Even with Pigpen’s absence, the set flows with relentless energy and only a tiny blemish (a gourd‑cluttered Dark Star) mars an otherwise flawless night.

ai_rating.rationale: The overwhelming majority of reviews are 5‑star, praising both the musical performance and the Miller soundboard upgrade; only minor critiques appear, yielding a near‑perfect combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Miller's restoration is lauded as crisp, clear and balanced.  No significant dropouts or noise are reported; a few reviewers note the obvious stage “hole” where Pigpen should be, but that concerns performance rather than audio.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A tight, high‑energy first set builds from a moody Dark Star into the explosive St. Stephen > The Eleven, then rolls through Death Don't Have No Mercy.  The second set peaks with a ferocious Other One, segues into New Potato Caboose and a wild, genre‑blending jam before closing.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for lyrical, dynamic playing; described as “Picasso of guitar” and “every note perfectly placed.”
band_member_comments.Phil: Highlighted for an astonishing ‘thirteens style’ solo and tight interplay with Garcia throughout the set.
band_member_comments.Bob: Mentioned only in passing (minor key transition call‑out); no specific performance commentary.
band_member_comments.Keys: Notably absent – reviewers point out a “hole on stage where Pig should be” and discuss how the show feels without Pigpen’s organ.
band_member_comments.Drums: Positive notes about a powerful drum segment before the jam and Billy’s expanded use of the trap kit.
